content: Export: Bluecoins exports transactions, reminders, and balance sheets to Excel/CSV and imports from CSV (official settings page). Money Manager backs up to Excel files. YNAB supports CSV export. CSV/Excel is the dominant export format in the category; PDF export is offered by several trackers (Money Manager PDF/Excel) but CSV is the standard interchange format. The project's PDF+Excel choice matches market norms; CSV would be a cheap, standard-compatible addition.
